message.content: {"note_claim": "Europeans have been using soap for thousands of years, long before the Moors colonised a small corner of Europe.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "It is another 2000 years before both Greek (Galen, Method of Medicine, VIII. line 569k) and Roman (Pliny, Natural History, XXVIII.191; Martial, Epigrams, VIII.20; XIV.27 & 27) authors mention soap.", "reason": "The page confirms that Greek and Roman authors were referencing soap by the first century AD, supporting the note's claim that Europeans used soap long before the Moorish colonization of Europe."}

parsed.note_claim: Europeans have been using soap for thousands of years, long before the Moors colonised a small corner of Europe.

parsed.quote: It is another 2000 years before both Greek (Galen, Method of Medicine, VIII. line 569k) and Roman (Pliny, Natural History, XXVIII.191; Martial, Epigrams, VIII.20; XIV.27 & 27) authors mention soap.
